_comment: Edit and rebuild. Resolvers are the choices on the Settings screen; defaultResolver is used until you pick one. Bootstrap IPs let the app reach DoH without asking any plain-text resolver first.

resolvers.name: Quad9
resolvers.note: Swiss non-profit run for public benefit. Blocks known malware and phishing domains, validates DNSSEC and never logs your IP address.

resolvers.name: Cloudflare
resolvers.note: Usually the fastest, thanks to a huge anycast network. No filtering at all. Privacy policy is independently audited and IP logs are deleted within 25 hours.

resolvers.name: Cloudflare Security
resolvers.note: Same network and privacy terms as Cloudflare (1.1.1.2), plus blocking of malware and phishing domains.

resolvers.name: Mullvad
resolvers.note: Run by the Swedish privacy-focused VPN provider. No filtering and no query logging, free for anyone.

resolvers.name: Mullvad Base
resolvers.note: Mullvad with its own ad, tracker and malware blocking on top. Same no-logging policy.

resolvers.name: AdGuard DNS
resolvers.note: From the AdGuard ad-blocker team (Cyprus). Blocks ads and trackers on its side as well, a second layer behind Wallupus.

resolvers.name: Google Public DNS
resolvers.note: Very fast and reliable, no filtering. Keeps temporary logs with your IP for 24–48 hours, plus anonymised long-term logs.

sources.name: Known DoH resolvers (stops apps bypassing the filter)
